reviewPolicy: Each revision is maintainer-reviewed. This file records project decisions, not automatic approvals.

differences.reason: Patched transitive dependencies address published security advisories. Ponder, OpenNext, and browser compatibility are verified before merge; imported source revisions are unchanged.
Cloudflare/OpenNext and portable Node deployments replace Vercel-specific services.
Domain-bound SIWE replaces arbitrary replayable signatures and proprietary identity.
Content-addressed R2/S3 storage replaces the original external upload service.
Verified transaction destinations are independent of upstream source updates.
Shared versioned community backend with author authorization and import provenance.

Original community procedures use the shared SIWE backend, complete pagination, owned albums and opaque identifiers. Owner-chosen profile names are distinct from verified naming records. The remaining original-client audit is documented before cutover.
